title: Giant exoplanet emerges from the dark when the James Webb Space Telescope turns out the starlight
caption:
Astronomers have found a way to see planets that were previously lost in the glare of their parent stars. By creating a digital twin of the James Webb Space Telescope, researchers can now subtract starlight to reveal hidden worlds.

Source: Space - Giant exoplanet emerges from the dark when the James Webb Space Telescope turns out the starlight
